title: Extensions validated against a held-out attempt (P5)
description: Each candidate structure is fitted on the training attempts and then tested on a held-out attempt: the held-out arc's local parameters are fitted with the training posterior of the global parameters as a prior, and T = chi2 + prior penalty is compared with its expectation. The right rule passes somewhere it never trained; the base structure and a wrong extension fail visibly.
units: SI: m, s, m/s, m/s^2, rad. Bearings are inertial angles from +x, wrapped to [-pi, pi).
frame: Planar inertial. Gauge: body A at the origin and at rest at t = 0 of every attempt (spec 3.4).

propagation.note: Reference setting; all times are multiples of dt. Any propagator whose position error over the arc is below ~1 m reproduces the expected values.

tolerance.numeric: Fits with compare = numeric: |x_impl - x_ref| <= 0.05 sigma_ref per parameter; |sigma_impl / sigma_ref - 1| <= 0.05; |chi2_impl / chi2_ref - 1| <= 0.02; |rho_impl - rho_ref| <= 0.02. Tier L windows: same boundaries (t0, t1, nFixes) and |g_impl - g_ref| <= 0.05 sigma_ref. Profile nodes: |g_impl - g_ref| <= 0.1 sigma_ref.
tolerance.qualitative: Fits with compare = qualitative are grossly misfitted (chi2/nu > 25) or unconverged; only the inequalities in `checks` and any heldOut.pass value are required.
tolerance.physicalClaims: Per check, stated in `checks`. The generator refuses to write a vector whose claims fail.

notes: heldOut.T, nu, TperNu, threshold and pass are part of the expected values. For fits marked compare = qualitative only pass/fail and the listed checks are required.
`truth` blocks are for checking only and must never reach the estimator (P11). Measurements whose target is not a modelled body are ignored by that fit.
